source.text: All entries › WebSocket Copy as Markdown Copied ← → WebSocket You might say How does a chat room receive new messages in real time? A connection that stays open, letting both sides send messages at any time·When building live chat or real-time collaborative editing, the client and server need to stay connected. Standard HTTP requests open and close for each question and answer; WebSocket stays open after connecting so either side can send messages at any time. Because persistent connections can drop on network glitches, they typically include heartbeat checks and auto-reconnect logic.
